question: Should this PR require live Cloudflare Sandbox proof before merge, or should maintainers intentionally accept the reporter-sample risk for this compatibility-sensitive detector change?
rationale: The code shape is narrow and tested, but the changed signal affects startup and plugin behavior for existing deployments, and the external PR has not shown the patched behavior in a real Cloudflare Sandbox container.

options.title: Require Live Cloudflare Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output or logs from a Cloudflare Sandbox or Cloudchamber container showing `/proc/1/cgroup` and the patched detector classifying it as a container before merge.

options.title: Accept Reporter-Sample Risk
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally land based on the issue's cgroup sample and the regression tests while owning the risk that real Cloudflare variants differ.

options.title: Consolidate Detectors First
options.body: Pause this PR and replace it with a detector consolidation plus the Cloudchamber matcher if duplicate shared/Bonjour detector drift is no longer acceptable.

recommendation.title: Require Live Cloudflare Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output or logs from a Cloudflare Sandbox or Cloudchamber container showing `/proc/1/cgroup` and the patched detector classifying it as a container before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the closest same-surface detector precedent and can best decide whether live platform proof is mandatory for this compatibility-sensitive path.
